title: Omnibus Goodness-of-Fit Testing for Distributions on Stiefel Manifolds
summary: In this article, a comprehensive framework for goodness-of-fit testing for distributions on Stiefel manifolds is developed. The approach is based on integrals of the squared differences between empirical and theoretical characteristic functions, yielding test statistics that are consistent against all fixed alternatives. For the Fisher-Bingham family of distributions, explicit computable forms of the test statistic are derived.
